item.title: Sigma Launches AF Cine 28-105mm T3 FF, new 35mm Art II, and 15mm Contemporary Lens for 2026
item.description: Sigma has announced release timing for three new lenses spanning its Contemporary, Art, and Cine ranges, with launches scheduled between mid-March and mid-April 2026, and including the long-awaited Sigma AF Cine Line 28-105mm T3 FF.

item.title: Nikon NIKKOR Z 70-200mm f/2.8 VR S II Announced: Faster AF, Lighter Build, Better Stabilisation
item.description: Nikon has introduced a new second-generation S-Line zoom ahead of CP+ 2026, the NIKKOR Z 70-200mm f/2.8 VR S II lens.

item.title: ASUS ProArt CaliContrO MCA02 Released: 3-in-1 Calibration and Control Device
item.description: The new ASUS ProArt CaliContrO MCA02 is a triple-function device combining calibration, monitor control, and app control in one unit.

item.title: Panasonic LUMIX DMW-DMS1 Microphone Announced: 32-bit Float, Hot-Shoe Audio, $399
item.description: Panasonic has announced the LUMIX DMW-DMS1, a compact on-camera digital shotgun microphone offering 32-bit float recording, six pickup modes, and cable-free hot-shoe connectivity for recent LUMIX mirrorless bodies.

item.title: Adobe Launches Quick Cut for Firefly Video Editor to Automate First Edits
item.description: Adobe has introduced Quick Cut, a new feature in the Firefly Video Editor designed to help creators rapidly assemble a structured first edit from raw footage or other assets.

item.title: ZEISS launches Otus ML 35mm f/1.4 Manual-Focus Lens for Mirrorless Cameras
item.description: ZEISS has introduced the Otus ML 1.4/35, adding a new wide-angle option to its manual-focus Otus ML mirrorless lens series alongside the existing 50mm and 85mm models.

item.title: Atomos Ninja RAW Announced: Affordable 5-inch HDR Recorder with ProRes RAW and 6K HDMI Capture
item.description: The new Atomos Ninja RAW delivers ProRes RAW recording and precision monitoring in a compact 5-inch (12.7 cm) form factor.

item.title: Canon Shows Waist-Level Retro Concept Camera at CP+ 2026
item.description: The most-talked about camera of CP+ 2026 so far doesn't exactly feature the latest tech and doesn't even exist beyond the prototype stage, but the new Canon waist-level concept camera is certainly turning heads.

item.title: Netflix Drops WBD Bid as Paramount Skydance Emerges as Only Likely Buyer
item.description: While regulatory hurdles are still in place, Netflix's refusal to raise its bid for Warner Bros. Discovery clears the way for Paramount Skydance to take ownership of the studio.
